data.title: 爱丽丝 · 晨曦微光中的金色温情
data.description: 清晨阳光照进静谧卧室，身穿纯白丝质睡袍的爱丽丝坐在床沿，金色的发辫垂在微露的雪白肩头，回眸注视着醒来的爱人，目光充满毫无保留的眷恋。
data.action: sitting on edge of bed, looking back over shoulder, sweet devoted smile
data.lighting: pristine morning sun rays illuminating flowing golden locks
data.promptProse: Perched gracefully at the edge of a sunlit bed in soft morning light, Alice looks over her shoulder in a white silk gown, her lustrous golden braid catching the daybreak glow with an affectionate smile.
data.animaCaption: Alice sitting at the edge of the bed with an affectionate morning smile.
